第7章轮回之地，太上三宝
“轮回者未通过试炼任务，没有权限查看任务……试炼任务将在一个时辰后开始，介时轮回者将被传送至任务世界……剩余停留时间——一个时辰。”
钱晨熟练的点开那张金色榜文，虽然还未通过任务获得奖励，但此时唯一能了解轮回之地的途径，就是这张兑换榜文。
榜文上兑换奖励的基本单位有三个，善德，功德和道德。
其中三千善德，可以换一功德，三千功德可以换一道德，这样看来太上道尘珠确实价值千万，在轮回之地的兑换榜文中，也是极为不凡的东西。
钱晨随手点开法宝条目，第一行便有：大日金钟，上古妖皇所炼，后天灵宝，兑换价格：三十亿道德。
后面几行也是信息量满满：
天帝大权，元阳上帝统御天庭所用玉玺，后天灵宝，兑换价格：二十五亿道德。
太上阴阳扇——太上玄阴扇（缺太上纯阳扇），太上道祖所炼传道之宝，后天灵宝，兑换价格：二十五亿道德。
灭世混一清浊大磨盘——覆地浊气大盘（缺倾天清气大磨），九幽魔祖所炼灭世之宝，后天灵宝，兑换价格：二十五亿道德。
十二品功德金莲（缺九品），佛祖所炼镇教之宝，先天灵宝，兑换价格：十五亿道德。
九天神雷真甲，上古雷神所炼护身之宝，后天灵宝，兑换价格：十五亿道德……
“太上阴阳扇，这不是太上三宝之一，兜率宫的镇教之宝吗？难道兜率宫也和楼观道一样，没落遭劫了？”钱晨看着兑换目录上一行文字，有些惊讶，这轮回之主果然有些大能，居然能搞来太上三宝之一的太上阴阳扇，虽然只有一半，但也非同小可。
太上三宝：太上八卦炉，太上阴阳扇，太上道尘珠，乃是昔年太上道祖成道前的随身之物，后来赐予门下，象征着太上道统的身份。获得此三宝的，便是太上道三支正传——太清宗，兜率宫，楼观道，那是真正视之道统的东西。
休看楼观道没落到本代只有一位结丹羽士，但只要手持三宝，在任何非这三个源头的太上道统面前，都是上宗。
钱晨不想回太上道，就是因为太上道若发现他的身份，不知有多少宗门要打的头破血流，然后胜利者兴高采烈的将他迎回宗门，奉为祖师，天天盼着他飞升，然后可以光明正大的宣告自己继承太上道尘珠代表的太上道统，从此成为太上真传。
这和清净无为无关，甚至和利益无关，而是道统所在……楼观道落魄到了这等地步，都没有任何道门敢窥视此宝，便是如此原因……
不然飞升上界，楼观道的前辈绝对要上来围观的。到时候那些道君们嘿嘿一笑：“小老弟，听说你动了我家镇教之宝。”来人岂不是要傻眼？
拿走兜率宫所持太上阴阳扇的一半，兜率宫就是脾气再好，也是要拼命的。
加上佛门镇教之宝，代表净土宗道统的九品金莲所缺三品，魔祖那边钱晨不是很清楚，但既然是九幽魔祖所传，那肯定也是九幽教的命根子。太古妖皇是妖族领袖，太古雷神是神庭重臣，加上前后九任天帝之一元阳上帝的大权。

轮回之地没被搞掉，说明后面的来头一定大得惊人。
不然佛道神妖魔几家，早就联手杀入轮回之地，把这些传承之宝统统抢走……
反正就钱晨所知，太上道绝不介意下界几个道君，净土宗也很乐意搬来自家的几尊菩萨，九幽教的魔尊也绝对摩拳擦掌，跃跃欲试。神道那几位上古大神也要有所意动，把天界分割成的九天的几位帝君，更不会介意派人夺走天帝大权，证明自己是天庭正统，好一统天界。
诸天万界，除去钱晨所在的神州浩土，其他各界只能称为万界。
只有上古天庭所在的天界，以及后来道门三位祖师开辟的三天，佛门二圣所在的西方二天，以及其他教主级人物开辟的道场，才能被称为天界。这些世界才是诸天！
钱晨暗暗咂舌，内心为轮回之主竖起一个大拇指，是个狠人。
不过他也十分郁闷的跳脚道：“轮回之主，为什么同为太上三宝，阴阳扇只有一半，就值二十五亿道德，而我的道尘珠是全的，才给开价三千万？你是不是看不起我道尘珠？”
“回收价，折有十一……”
那浩大的声音回应道：“太上道尘珠，乃先天灵宝，并无攻伐之能，也无护身之妙，不能镇教，亦不能灭世，乃是悟道之宝，象征太上道统。然而其对太上道统之外的使用者用处有限，而且悟道之妙，似乎也并不突出。故而诸天评定此宝地位虽高，妙用却弱。”
“如天帝大权一般，乃是象征之宝。”
“然元阳上帝道统并无人继承，太上道的道统却早有定论。”
“也就是说这东西对于大能来说就是鸡肋，搞上手没什么用不说，而却绝对会被楼观道的几位道君视为死敌，说不定文始道尊也会出手。”钱晨叹息道：“除了我之外，就没几个能名正言顺，拥有此珠的人了。”

Chapter 7 The Land of Reincarnation, the Three Supreme Treasures
"The reincarnator has not passed the trial mission and does not have permission to view the mission...The trial mission will start in one hour, and the reincarnator will be transferred to the mission world...the remaining stay time is one hour."
Qian Chen skillfully clicked on the golden list. Although he had not yet obtained the reward through the mission, the only way to understand the land of reincarnation at this time was through this exchange list.
There are three basic units for redeeming rewards on the list: kindness, merit and morality.
Among them, three thousand good virtues can be exchanged for one meritorious virtue, and three thousand meritorious virtues can be exchanged for one virtue. It seems that the Taishangdao Chen Bead is indeed worth tens of millions. It is also an extremely extraordinary thing in the exchange list of the Land of Reincarnation.
Qian Chen casually clicked on the magic weapon entry, and the first line read: The Great Sun Golden Bell, refined by the ancient demon emperor, acquired spiritual treasure, exchange price: three billion morals.
The next few lines are also full of information:
The power of the Emperor of Heaven, the jade seal used by Yuanyang God to rule the heaven, acquired spiritual treasure, exchange price: 2.5 billion morals.
Taishang Yin Yang Fan - Taishang Xuanyin Fan (missing Taishang Pure Yang Fan), the treasure of preaching refined by Taishang Taoist Ancestor, acquired spiritual treasure, exchange price: 2.5 billion morals.
The world-destroying great millstone of pure and turbid energy - the great disc of earth-covering turbid energy (missing the great millstone of pure and clear energy from the sky), the world-destroying treasure refined by the Nine Nether Demon Ancestor, the acquired spiritual treasure, exchange price: 2.5 billion morals.
Twelve-grade Golden Lotus of Merit and Virtue (ninth grade is missing), a treasure refined by the Buddha to suppress the teachings, an innate spiritual treasure, exchange price: 1.5 billion virtues.
Nine Heavens Divine Thunder True Armor, a protective treasure refined by the ancient God of Thunder, acquired spiritual treasure, exchange price: 1.5 billion morals...
"The Taishang Yin-Yang Fan, isn't this one of the Three Supreme Treasures, the treasure of the Tusita Palace that suppresses the religion? Could it be that the Tusita Palace, like Lou Guan Tao, has declined and been robbed?" Qian Chen looked at the line of text in the redemption catalog and was a little surprised. The Lord of Samsara is really powerful. He was able to get the Taishang Yin-Yang Fan, one of the Three Supreme Treasures. Although it was only half of it, it was no small feat.
The Three Supreme Treasures: the Supreme Bagua Furnace, the Supreme Yin-Yang Fan, and the Supreme Dao Chen Bead were the belongings of the Supreme Taoist ancestor before he became a Taoist. They were later given to his disciples, symbolizing the identity of the Supreme Taoist lineage. Those who have obtained these three treasures are the three true traditions of Taishang Taoism - Taiqing Sect, Tushita Palace, and Louguan Taoism. They are the true traditions of Taoism.
The decline of Kanlouguan Taoism has led to the fact that there is only one alchemy Taoist priest in this generation, but as long as he holds the Three Treasures, he is the Supreme Sect in front of any Taishang Taoist lineage that does not originate from these three sources.
Qian Chen didn't want to go back to Taishang Dao, because if Taishang Dao discovered his identity, countless sects would be beaten to death. Then the victors would happily welcome him back to their sect and worship him as their ancestor. They looked forward to his ascension every day, and then he could openly and honestly declare that he inherited the Taishang Taoism represented by Taishang Dao Chenzhu, and from then on became the true successor of Taishang.
This has nothing to do with purity and inaction, or even interests, but rather the place of Taoism... Louguan Taoism has reached such a state of decline that no Taoist sect dares to peep at this treasure. This is the reason...
Otherwise, when he ascends to the upper world, seniors from Louguan Dao will definitely come up to watch. At that time, those Dao Lords laughed and said: "Little brother, I heard that you touched my family's teaching treasure." Wouldn't the visitor be dumbfounded?
Take away half of the Taishang Yin-Yang Fan held by Tushita Palace, and Tushita Palace will fight tooth and nail no matter how good-tempered he is.
In addition, the nine-grade Golden Lotus, which is the treasure of Buddhism and represents the Pure Land Sect, is missing three grades. Qian Chen, the Demon Ancestor, is not very clear, but since it was passed down by the Jiuyou Demon Ancestor, it must be the lifeblood of the Jiuyou Sect. The Ancient Demon Emperor is the leader of the demon clan, and the Ancient Thunder God is an important minister of the Divine Court. In addition, he has the power of Yuanyang God, one of the nine previous Heavenly Emperors.
The fact that the Land of Reincarnation has not been destroyed means that the backstory must be astonishingly big.
Otherwise, Buddhists, Taoists, gods and demons would have joined forces to enter the land of reincarnation and snatched away all these inherited treasures...
Anyway, as far as Qian Chen knows, Taishangdao will never mind going down.Several Dao Lords from the world, the Pure Land Sect are also happy to move a few Bodhisattvas from home, and the Demon Lord from the Jiuyou Sect is definitely gearing up and eager to give it a try. The ancient gods of Shinto must also have some intentions. The emperors of the nine heavens who divided the heavens will not mind sending people to take away the power of the heavenly emperor to prove that they are the orthodox of heaven and unify the heavens.
All the worlds in the world, except for the vast land of China where Qian Chen is located, all other worlds can only be called ten thousand worlds.
Only the heaven where the ancient heaven is located, as well as the three days opened by the three founders of the Taoist sect, the two western days where the two Buddhist saints are located, and the dojos opened by other leader-level figures can be called the heaven. These worlds are the heavens!
Qian Chen secretly smacked his tongue and gave a thumbs up to the Lord of Reincarnation. He was a ruthless person.
However, he also jumped to his feet very depressed and said: "Lord of Reincarnation, why are we both the Supreme Three Treasures? The Yin-Yang Fan is only half worth 2.5 billion virtues, but my Daochen Bead is complete, so you are asking for 30 million? Do you look down on my Daochen Bead?"
"The recycling price is discounted by 11%..."
The loud voice responded: "The Taishang Daochen Pearl is an innate spiritual treasure. It has no ability to attack or protect the body. It cannot suppress religions and cannot destroy the world. It is a treasure of enlightenment and symbolizes the Taishang Taoism. However, its use is limited for users outside the Taishang Taoism, and the beauty of enlightenment does not seem to be outstanding. Therefore, the heavens judged that although the status of this treasure is high, the magical effect is weak."
"Like the power of the Emperor of Heaven, it is a symbolic treasure."
"However, there is no one to inherit the Yuanyang God's orthodoxy, but the Taishangdao's orthodoxy has long been finalized."
"That is to say, this thing is useless to powerful people. There is no use in getting it. However, it will definitely be regarded as the mortal enemy by the Taoist Lords of Louguan Dao. Maybe Taoist Wenshi will also take action." Qian Chen sighed: "Besides me, there are few people who can claim to own this bead."
